title: Tôi đã đặt dịch vụ đón tại sân bay
englishTitle: I have an airport pickup booked
pronunciation: Toi da dat dich vu don tai san bay
summary: I have an airport pickup booked

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Use Tôi đã đặt dịch vụ đón tại sân bay when the passport, baggage tag, flight detail, or pickup screen is already part of the moment.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Start with Tôi đã đặt dịch vụ đón tại sân bay; then point to the passport, baggage tag, flight detail, or pickup screen if the other.

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: If the exchange continues, where is immigration?; where is baggage claim?; where can I buy a SIM card? can carry the next detail.

phrases.english: Where can I buy a SIM card?

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Reach for it at an airport counter, baggage area, or pickup point when the other person needs one clear arrival or airport detail.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Airport staff and drivers are used to short, practical questions. Keep the document or phone screen visible so they can answer quickly.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Keep close by: Where is the pickup area, Where do I meet the driver, and My bag did not arrive.
